theorems.name: Submission.rsdic_tl_blowUp_measure_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (r R : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < r → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S ∩ closedBall 0 R) = (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹ ^ n * μHE[n] (S ∩ closedBall x (r * R))
